name: Moon Glow
description: Bring a steady moonglow to the eyes to see clearly in dark rooms.

name: Lunar Grasp
description: Close an unseen grip of pull round a foe's wrist and hold it.

name: Silver Stride
description: Cross ground in long weightless strides lit by pale light.

name: Half Veil
description: Draw half the light from a blow so it lands softly.

name: Heavy Phase
description: Raise the pull on a foe's body to many times its weight.

name: Moonbeam Lance
description: Gather a beam of pale light and throw it through a foe's guard.

name: Greater Pull
description: Pull a strong foe to the ground with a heavy lunar weight and hold the foe there.

name: Full Radiance
description: Burst a full-moon radiance over a wide front that burns pale and pushes everything outward.

name: Wan Glow
description: Spread a faint moonglow through the qi field to show what moves in it.

name: Tidal Tug
description: Pull at a foe through the field to unsettle a step.

name: Reach Push
description: Send a push through the field into a foe beyond arm's reach.

name: Distant Halo
description: Ring the user with a halo that dims whatever strikes it.

name: Tidal Drag
description: Fill the field with a tide that drags at all within it.

name: Hidden Wake
description: Wake the latent strength of allies across the field in turn.

name: Phase Shift
description: Move the user's presence one phase aside so a blow goes through the old place.

name: Far Pull
description: Seize a distant foe with the field's pull and draw the foe in.

name: Cresting Tide
description: Raise a tide through the whole field that rolls over foes and drags them back.

name: Bright Half
description: Strike with the lit half of the hand while the dark half hides the blow's start.

name: Dark Half
description: Drop the unlit half of the body into shade so blows pass through it.

name: Phase Pair
description: Step from a bright patch to a shaded one in a single bound.

name: Pair Reading
description: Read both phases of a thing at once to see its lit face and its hidden face.

name: Twin Face
description: Show a false bright face and a true shaded one so a blow lands on the false.

name: Matched Pull
description: Pair a pull from the front with a pull from behind so a foe cannot step either way.

name: Eclipse Pair
description: Cross two phases over a foe so the foe loses sight and weight together.

name: Twin Tide
description: Raise a tide from each side that meet over the middle and crush foes between them.

name: Gentle Glow
description: Fill a hollow in the field with soft glow to show who moves in it.

name: Draw Down
description: Draw a foe's lifted foot down with a sudden weight.

name: Run Out
description: Release a small stored tide of force into a foe's side.

name: Level Sense
description: Feel the level of pull in the field and where it sinks.

name: Pooling Pull
description: Gather the pull of the field into a pool at a foe's feet.

name: Brimming Gift
description: Fill an ally with the stored tide until the ally brims with strength.

name: Overflow Push
description: Spill the pool outward in a push that clears the space round the user.

name: Drawing Moon
description: Hold a foe at the centre of a bowl of pull so every step slides back.

name: Surging Tide
description: Loose the stored tide as a river of force that bowls over a line of foes.

name: Gust Pull
description: Pull a foe's blade hand sideways on a gust of lunar qi.

name: Sworn Push
description: Push a foe back with a force sworn to stay at the user's word.

name: Tide Bearing
description: Hold a firm bearing against the tide so it passes the user by.

name: Wind Gleam
description: Follow a gleam carried on the wind to find a hidden foe.

name: Oath Tide
description: Lay a tide on a foe that rises each time the foe breaks a promise.

name: Held Moon
description: Hold a steady lunar glow over allies so their stances do not drift.

name: Bearing Pull
description: Pull a charging foe round the user's held bearing and hold the foe there.

name: Unwalled Radiance
description: Open a wide radiance with no wall behind it that pushes every foe back.

name: Far Gleam
description: Send a gleam across a wide stretch to show what moves at its far end.

name: Edge Pull
description: Pull at the outer edge of a foe's stance to unseat the step.

name: Long Push
description: Push a foe far away with a long unbroken thrust of lunar force.

name: Distant Glow
description: Cast a glow far ahead that turns blows aimed at the user.

name: Reach Step
description: Let the far pull draw the body across a wide gap.

name: Long Tide
description: Run a long tide through the field that slows every foe it passes.

name: Distant Wake
description: Wake the dormant strength of an ally across the field.

name: Bearing Phase
description: Shift the user one phase along the bearing so a blow passes through the old place.

name: Remote Tide
description: Press a heavy tide on a far foe with no line between them.

name: Far Radiance
description: Open a far radiance over a wide area that pushes and sears all within.
